title: I'd like to use my phone

messages.text: I'd like to use my phone

Yes, the phone is yours: no test needs it for the next 4-6 hours.
- Nothing is booked on it; ignore any "re-plug the cable" step, I withdraw those.
- The next phone use is the g0 Try-it (v14 vs the original end-of-page on the GPU); I will ask first.

What you need to do: nothing; plug it back in when you are done.

Re-planned: all work now runs without your phone; it needs the phone again only for the final timing test, and only when you hand it back.

| Order | Work | Runs on | Needs your phone |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | g0.0: v14 with the original end-of-page | Chrome + Simulator | no |
| 2 | g0.1: that end-of-page on the GPU | Chrome + Simulator | no |
| 3 | Try-it pages A (v14) / B (g0) / original | your phone over Wi-Fi, no cable | only to look, when you like |
| 4 | Timing test g0 vs v14 on the cable | iPhone | yes, after you say "phone free" |

- The paused v14-based design test (P-163) stays parked; g0 replaces that line.
- Re-plug steps from the USB watch are withdrawn while you use the phone.

What you need to do: nothing; say "phone free" here when the phone can go back on the cable.

Thanks: the iPhone is back on the cable (connection #138) and the USB watch is back to normal.
- No phone test is due yet: g0.0 (v14 with the original end-of-page) is in its pixel checks, g0.1 (its GPU version) is fixing one extra memory layer in Safari.
- Next phone use: the g0 Try-it (v14 / g0 / original), then the timing test; I will post both as steps.

What you need to do: nothing; you may keep using the phone until a step appears.
